eventTypes.title: Event types
eventTypes.description: new_company, name_change, liquidation, liquidation_ended, bankruptcy, bankruptcy_ended, restructuring, dissolution, removal, merger, demerger, registered_office_change, articles_amended, industry_change

dateFrom.title: From (YYYY-MM-DD)
dateFrom.description: Registration date window start (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: yesterday (or since last run in alert mode).

dateTo.title: To (YYYY-MM-DD)
dateTo.description: Registration date window end (YYYY-MM-DD). Default: today.

location.title: Town / city
location.description: Optional registered-office town filter, e.g. Helsinki.

companyForm.title: Company form
companyForm.description: Optional PRH company form code: OY, OYJ, OK, KY, AY, SÄÄ, ...

maxPerEvent.title: Max records per event type
maxPerEvent.description: Maximum number of company events to fetch per requested event type.

watchBusinessIds.title: Watchlist Business IDs
watchBusinessIds.description: Optional list of Y-tunnus (1234567-8). Each run compares with the previous snapshot and emits change events.

alertMode.title: Alert mode (only new events)
alertMode.description: Return only events not seen in previous runs with the same alert key.

alertStateKey.title: Alert / watchlist key
alertStateKey.description: State key used to isolate alert and watchlist state across saved schedules.
